{{Top|leg}}
'''Starport Touchdown''' was a limited services [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Trilos]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Atraken]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it served as the primary starport for the lunar [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations. With the arrival of [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] from [[Atraken/Legends|Atraken]] and the establishment of a larger [[Atrakenite]] civilization on Trilos, the spaceport fell into disuse, with only [[free-trader]]s utilizing it. Two Atrakenite [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]], ''[[Atraken Hope]]'' and ''[[Atraken Memory]]'', were berthed at the port. Starport Touchdown was linked to [[New Atraken City]] via access paths.
